candidate.sourceProvenance: Immutable image ID and producer-supplied OCI revision label; no signed build attestation

scope: Local Docker gateway and image ingestion consumers sharing an isolated PostgreSQL container network; not enterprise HA certification

databaseProfile.scope: Owned local test database; PostgreSQL execution statistics exclude client/pool/network time. Cluster WAL includes all databases on this owned test instance.
databaseProfile.blockerScope: Sampled blocker statement categories and transaction age; a transaction can retain locks acquired by an earlier statement. Fixed SQL-side labels only, no query text, parameters, backend IDs or credentials retained.

backlogDuringLoad.scope: Sampled during offered load, before receipt drain. Fixture receipts and initial event-side-effect lanes only; excludes child/provider jobs and external delivery. Two aggregate queries per sample add diagnostic overhead. Not downstream certification.

admissionQuiescence.scope: Disposable HTTP fixture admission closed after offered load; pre-barrier database transactions settled before final reconciliation. Policy remains paused through topology cleanup. Not notification drain or HTTP timeout prevention.

sideEffectJobs.scope: Measured fixture incident outbox jobs after receipt drain; excludes preflight, other job families and external-provider completion. Not a downstream drain certification.
